Method of Attack: Splitting malicious behavior into a second-stage component
First-stage apps with legitimate code to bypass Google Bouncer
Second-stage component disguised as license verification
Scanning device for data and rooting device using known exploits
Call recording, VOIP recording, microphone recording
Location monitoring, screenshots, photos with camera
Fetching device and user information including contacts, call logs, SMS, application-specific data
Retrieving data from apps: Gmail, Hangouts, KakaoTalk, LinkedIn, Messenger, Skype, Snapchat, StockEmail, Telegram, Threema, Viber, Whatsapp
Attack Vector: Malicious apps uploaded to Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: 20 apps infected with Lipizzan found on fewer than 100 devices, some apps available on official Google Play Store
